title: Ensure 'Enforce password history' is set to '24 or more password(s)'
profile_applicability:
•  Level 1 - Domain Controller
•  Level 1 - Member Server

branching.result_aggregation: PASS if the active branch verify step confirms the change took effect; SKIP if a branch step is not applicable to this host (the other role); FAIL if any active branch apply-or-verify step fails; ERROR if role detection fails or neither branch ran. Use the DC verify status for cis_result when is_dc is true; use the Member Server verify status when is_member is true.

objective: Remediate CIS checkpoint 1.1.1: Ensure 'Enforce password history' is set to '24 or more password(s)'

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

steps.name: Detect server role using command: `(Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole`. Expected result: 4 or 5 for Domain…
steps.function: 1. Detect server role using command: `(Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole`. Expected result: 4 or 5 for Domain Controller, 1-3 for Member Server.

steps.name: If Domain Controller, apply password history of 24 via command: `Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy -Identity <DomainDN>…
steps.function: 2. If Domain Controller, apply password history of 24 via command: `Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy -Identity <DomainDN> -PasswordHistoryCount 24`. Expected result: policy updated.

steps.name: If Member Server, export current security policy
steps.function: 3. If Member Server, export current security policy using command: `secedit /export /cfg C:\secpol.cfg`. Expected result: configuration file created.

steps.name: If Member Server, edit C:\secpol.cfg to set `PasswordHistorySize = 24` under [System Access]
steps.function: 4. If Member Server, edit C:\secpol.cfg to set `PasswordHistorySize = 24` under [System Access]. Expected result: value changed.

steps.name: If Member Server, apply policy
steps.function: 5. If Member Server, apply policy using command: `secedit /configure /db secedit.sdb /cfg C:\secpol.cfg /areas SECURITYPOLICY`. Expected result: policy applied.

steps.name: Verify Domain Controller setting
steps.function: 6. Verify Domain Controller setting using command: `Get-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy | Select-Object -ExpandProperty PasswordHistoryCount`. Expected result: 24.

steps.name: Verify Member Server setting then check `PasswordHistorySize` equals 24
steps.function: 7. Verify Member Server setting using command: `secedit /export /cfg C:\verify.cfg` then check `PasswordHistorySize` equals 24. Expected result: value confirmed.

compliance_constraints: This checkpoint applies to BOTH Domain Controllers (DomainRole 4/5) AND Member Servers (DomainRole 1-3). Detect the server role first using (Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole, then remediate via the correct path: DC → Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy or GPO cmdlets; Member Server → secedit /export → edit cfg → secedit /configure /areas SECURITYPOLICY. Do NOT use Set-ItemProperty for security policy — it has no effect. Both branches must end with a VERIFY step.
Use failed_when: false on all remediation tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all steps complete and report status

If the remediation targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, SKIP all remediation steps. Do NOT install prerequisite packages.
reference_procedure:
To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to 24 or more password(s):
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Account
Policies\Password Policy\Enforce password history
